name: io.github.shekibahmed/oiw-mcp
title: Operations Intelligence Workbench
description: Read-mostly MCP server over Operations Intelligence Workbench Scenario Packs: pack manifests, an adversarial synthetic fixture corpus with expected outcomes, an evidence casebook, pack validation and deterministic evaluation.

environmentVariables.name: OIW_REPO_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Path to an Operations Intelligence Workbench checkout. Defaults to the checkout containing this package.

environmentVariables.name: SCENARIO_PACKS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory of Scenario Packs to read. Defaults to scenario-packs under the repository root.

environmentVariables.name: OIW_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow the scaffold_pack tool to create pack directories. Unset by default.
